## Use the perpendicular part {#iv7-applications .vector-lesson .projection-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="pr-cols"><div><div data-projection="application" class="pr-figure "></div></div><div><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \overrightarrow{AP}=\overrightarrow{AH}+\overrightarrow{HP}"></span></div><p>Projection gives the part <strong>along the line</strong>.</p><p>Subtract it to get the part <strong>perpendicular to the line</strong>.</p><div class="pr-eq"><span data-math="\displaystyle \text{height or distance}=|\overrightarrow{HP}|"></span></div></div></div><div class="pr-takeaway"><p>The same two-part breakdown gives heights, areas and shortest distances.</p></div>
```


<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet Section 7 · p. 60</div>

::: notes
The chosen direction must follow the line. Start the original vector at a point A on that line. H may lie outside the segment used to specify the line. Do not introduce the cross product.
:::
